source.title: 电路与模拟电子技术授课计划20260913

editionNote.zh: 授课计划列电路教材第4版；习题按用户提供并确认可用的第3版抄录与解答。题目实际来源始终标注第3版。
editionNote.en: The plan names Circuit Analysis, 4th edition. Exercises are transcribed and solved from the supplied 3rd edition, as confirmed by the user. Actual sources are labeled 3rd edition.

courses.book: 电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等

scope.zh: 第10章与模电第6章合讲；课件明确模电仅引言、6.1概念，电路第10章具体深度待课堂要求确认
scope.en: Chapter 10 is combined with Analog Chapter 6. Analog coverage is introduction and §6.1 concepts only; the depth of Circuit Chapter 10 is not specified in the plan.

excluded.zh: 第4、6、8、9、11、12、13章未列入讲授范围；第2章2.6起、第3章3.6起、第5章5.10起、第7章7.7起不进入默认考试学习路线。
excluded.en: Chapters 4, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12 and 13 are not listed. Sections 2.6 onward, 3.6 onward, 5.10 onward and 7.7 onward are excluded from the default exam route.

courses.book: 电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等

scope.zh: 第6章：引言、6.1，仅概念性；并入电路第10章
scope.en: Chapter 6: introduction and §6.1, concepts only; combined with Circuit Chapter 10

excluded.zh: 其余小节不进入默认考试路线。特别区分：MOSFET多级放大4.7在范围内；BJT 5.2.5不在范围内；第9、11章不在范围内；10.8.2方波发生器等不在范围内。
excluded.en: Other sections are excluded from the default exam route. MOSFET multistage §4.7 is included; BJT §5.2.5, Chapters 9 and 11, and §10.8.2 square-wave generation are excluded.
